tw-mi-wabasis-tower-road-bank-caves.t: 1894 plate: 'C. O. Tower 35' in the E part of NE¼ sec 29 on the N-S road to the NW shore of the W lobe (M. A. Tower 40 W of it; S. Tower 40 in S sec 29). Lidar: an oval pitted enclosure at 43.1419,-85.3979 on the Tower land, 300 m NW of the cut bank, is unexplained (old gravel digging or root cellars?); worth a look.

pinev: 1896 Oakland County atlas, Holly Twp: 'Thomas H. Fagan 230' in sec 16 T5N R7E (BLM section 42.828-42.843, -83.649 to -83.629), with W. H., L. E., E. A. and John Fagan on neighbouring land and a Fagan Lake. The 1893 farm was Thomas's 200 acres, the heir's 1896 holding on the same ground. Tract centre as read by the project; no house mark used; r400.
Atlas leaf: archive.org 3927794.0001.001 leaf 31 (Holly p. 23). Family land about 700 acres in secs 11/15/16/22; Fagan Lake in secs 10-11.
